consumer: An engine condition/dialogue eligibility check (the conditional_t has_items lambda) asking the yes/no question: does the avatar have at least 30 of 9mm on their person?
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory), not items reachable or on the ground nearby
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id, count) || actor->has_amount(item_id, count), the engine-computed possession predicate over the actor
divergence: Avatar carries one 9mm magazine loaded with 20 rounds while a box of 15 loose 9mm rounds sits on the adjacent floor: the on-person predicate must return false (only 20 carried), but a re-derivation summing reachable/nearby ammo wrongly returns true.
